item.title: KAITLAN COLLINS on why she LOVES Alabama football! ✈️ TRUMP coming to Alabama-Georgia
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description:
Kaitlan Collins is back! The Alabama native and CNN star is a die-hard Crimson Tide fan who loves to talk about her fandom whenever she gets the chance. Collins talks about the 2026 season so far, the job Kalen DeBoer is doing in year three, what she thinks of QB Keelon Russell, and much more. And just when she thought she would sneak away from Washington D.C. to catch a Bama in person, President Donald Trump announces he will attend the Tide's game against Georgia. Collins shares her thoughts on Trump coming back to Tuscaloosa and what it's like covering him 24/7. And Kaitlan plays our new game, "DC or D.C." Also, some thoughts on the passing of former Alabama head coach Dennis Franchione, with AL.com's Creg Stephenson.
